# Enlighten Publications - University of Glasgow Institutional Repository

> Enlighten Publications is the University of Glasgow's open-access institutional repository for scholarly research outputs and academic publications.

Enlighten serves as the central hub for discovering, accessing, and managing research publications from University of Glasgow researchers. The repository provides open access to peer-reviewed articles, theses, and other scholarly works, supporting the university's commitment to research visibility and knowledge dissemination.

## Repository Home & Discovery

- [Welcome to Enlighten Publications](https://eprints.gla.ac.uk): Homepage for University of Glasgow's institutional repository and open-access publications
- [Latest Additions to Enlighten Publications](https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/cgi/latest): Feed of latest research publications added to Enlighten repository
- [Latest 20 Additions to Enlighten Publications](https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/cgi/latest_tool): Tool displaying 20 most recent scholarly works in Enlighten repository
